title: Pentagon Renames CDAO ‘Super Intelligence Office’
description: The Pentagon has renamed its Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office (CDAO) to the Super Intelligence Office following an executive order directing federal agencies to replace the term 'artificial intelligence' with 'super intelligence' in official communications. The office continues its existing programs and partnerships without interruption, focusing on military applications of AI, now termed 'super intelligence'. This change is primarily terminological and organizational, reflecting a strategic shift in branding rather than introducing a new technical vulnerability or threat.
